claims.text: 3v1 overload on the right in the middle third

json.why: With a 3v1 overload on the right in the middle third, Kian Marchetti opts to pass to Fintan Valcourt instead of carrying down the flank. Although Kian Strand intercepts the 57% pass, attempting the pass carries a 4% goal chance for Ironvale compared to 2% from carrying.
